notes.title: Patch 1.1: The Locomotion Update!
notes.content:
We here at Sunset Division couldn't be happier with how much y'all are liking The Rig! We've heard some feedback regarding our default teleport locomotion and some performance issues and have been working hard to address it. 

With that said, we're happy to announce our first major patch. Check out the notes below!

[b][h2]Locomotion Options[/h2][/b]
By far the biggest thing you have requested is locomotion options, so here you go!

[list]
[*] Choose between Teleport and Smooth Locomotion (with 2 different speed settings)
[*] Choose between Snap Turn, Smooth Turn, or No Turning
[*] Choose which hand controls movement vs. turning
[/list]


[b][h2]Quality/Performance Options[/h2][/b]
We know that for many of you, frame rate is SUPER important. That's why we've added some basic performance options that you can tweak. 

[list]
[*] Overall quality options
[*] Toggle HBAO (Horizon Based Ambient Occlusion): NOTE: If you're having performance issues, disabling this option should give you a big improvement
[/list]


Thank you all for your feedback and for playing our little game. Please keep it coming!

Love,
Sunset Division
